<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require __DIR__ . '/../src/Accessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php';
require __DIR__ . '/../src/Formats/JsonAccessor.php';

use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\EnvAccessor;
use Synthetic\Accessors\Formats\JsonAccessor;

$failures = 0;
function check(string $name, bool $ok): void
{
    global $failures;
    echo ($ok ? "ok   " : "FAIL ") . $name . "\n";
    if (!$ok) {
        $failures++;
    }
}

$env = new EnvAccessor("HOST=localhost\nPORT=3000\n");
check('reads KEY=value lines', $env->get('HOST') === 'localhost' && $env->get('PORT') === '3000');

$env = new EnvAccessor("# a comment\n\nKEY=value\n");
check('skips blank lines and comments', $env->all() === ['KEY' => 'value']);

$env = new EnvAccessor("A=\"one two\"\nB='three'\n");
check('strips one pair of matching quotes', $env->get('A') === 'one two' && $env->get('B') === 'three');

$env = new EnvAccessor('KEY=value');
check('answers the fallback for a key that is not there', $env->get('MISSING', 'none') === 'none' && $env->has('KEY') && !$env->has('MISSING'));

$json = new JsonAccessor('{"name":"x","count":3}');
check('json keeps the string values of an object', $json->all() === ['name' => 'x']);

exit($failures === 0 ? 0 : 1);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Synthetic\Accessors\Formats;

use Synthetic\Accessors\Accessor;

/** Reads `KEY=value` lines. Blank lines and lines that start with `#` are skipped; a value may be wrapped in one pair of matching quotes. */
final class EnvAccessor implements Accessor
{
    /** @var array<string, string> */
    private array $values = [];

    public function __construct(string $source)
    {
        foreach (preg_split('/\r?\n/', $source) ?: [] as $raw) {
            $line = trim($raw);
            if ($line === '' || str_starts_with($line, '#')) {
                continue;
            }
            $eq = strpos($line, '=');
            if ($eq === false || $eq === 0) {
                continue;
            }
            $key = trim(substr($line, 0, $eq));
            $value = trim(substr($line, $eq + 1));
            if (strlen($value) >= 2 && ($value[0] === '"' || $value[0] === "'") && $value[strlen($value) - 1] === $value[0]) {
                $value = substr($value, 1, -1);
            }
            $this->values[$key] = $value;
        }
    }

    public function get(string $key, ?string $fallback = null): ?string
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?? $fallback;
    }

    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->values);
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return $this->values;
    }
}

input.title: EnvAccessor drops a leading `export` followed by spaces or tabs, in both packages
input.rationale: `export KEY=value` is a shell habit, so a line written that way is read exactly as `KEY=value`. The prefix is removed from the trimmed line before the blank/comment check, so `export # note` is a comment and `export NOVALUE` is skipped, as if the prefix were absent. It applies once, so `export export=1` has the key `export`. The prefix needs at least one space or tab after `export`, so `export=kept` and `exportKEY=y` keep their own keys. Made in both `packages/js` and `packages/php` in the same change, as ADR-1 requires. The match is the ASCII class `[ \t]+` in both.
input.alternatives: `\s+` after `export`: turned down, JS `\s` matches Unicode whitespace (NBSP and others) and PHP `\s` without /u does not, so the two packages would disagree on the same input. Strip the prefix only after the comment check: turned down, `export #X=1` would then define a key named `#X`, unlike `#X=1`, which is a comment. Match a literal `export ` (one space) only: turned down, `export\tKEY=v` would keep the key `export\tKEY`. Accept `export` with no following whitespace: turned down, it would swallow a key that is really named `export`.

content.text:
`EnvAccessor` now reads `export KEY=value` as `KEY=value`, in both the JS and PHP packages. Both test suites pass, JS 8/8 and PHP all `ok`.

ADR-1 says a behaviour change in one package is made in the other in the same change, so I changed both. This repo has no `parity-vectors.json`. Each package's own test run is the parity check.

- **Behaviour:** the prefix is removed once, before the blank and comment checks, so the line is handled exactly as if `export ` weren't there. The change is in `packages/js/src/accessors/formats/env-accessor.ts` and `packages/php/src/Formats/EnvAccessor.php`.
  - `export # note` is a comment.
  - `export NOVALUE` is skipped.
  - `export=kept` and `exportKEY=y` keep their own keys, because the prefix needs a space or tab after `export`.
- **Whitespace:** I match spaces and tabs only (`[ \t]+`), not `\s`. JS `\s` matches Unicode whitespace and PHP's doesn't, which would make the two packages disagree on the same line.
- **Tests:** two new tests in each package. One covers the basic case, including a quoted value, several spaces and a tab. The other covers the edge cases above.
- **Record:** I recorded this as ADR-2, with the alternatives I turned down, in `.mnema/`. It is awaiting acceptance.

Nothing is committed. `git status` shows the four source and test files plus new files under `.mnema/`, which are ADR-2 and this session's signing key. They should go in the same commit as the code.

When I first edited a file, a hook reported that this session's key founded a new identity in the public record, `mnema:65336f82`, next to the existing `3b2c3f61`. If that key is yours on another machine, the record will count you twice. The hook's note describes `mnema key request --anchor mnid:3b2c3f61` for that case. I didn't act on it.
